import os,glob,re,json
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def norm(cells):
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    return sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells)
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    cs=comps2(gi); cc=comps2(go)
    print('===',k)
    for i,s in enumerate(sorted(cs,key=lambda s:(min(r for r,c in s)))):
        n=norm(s)
        # try all dihedral transforms on n
        t=n; rev=t[::-1]; T=[list(x for x in t); rev:=t[::-1]]
        def tforms(shape):
            res=[]
            for name,shp in (('id',shape),('vflip',[(-r,-c) for r,c in shape]),('hflip',[-c for r,c in shape]),
                             ('rot180',[(-r,-c) for r,c in shape]),('rot90',[(c,-r) for r,c in shape]),('rot270',[(-c,r) for r,c in shape])):
                m=(min(r for r,c in shp),min(c for r,c in shp))
                res.append((name,[rr+m[1],cc+m[0] for rr,cc in sorted(shp)]))
            return res
        cands=[t for _,t in tforms(n)]
        found=[s2 for s2 in cc if any(c==norm(s2) for c in cands)]
        print(i,'in norm:',n,'matches out norms:',found)
